name: RANHILL
recent: Ranhill Utilities Berhad 近期主要围绕股东变动、公司秘书与注册处更换，以及即将召开的第十二届常年股东大会。大股东 Prudential PLC 与 Eastspring Investments Berhad 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。公司截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止年度营收与净利均同比增长。
notable: Prudential PLC 与 Eastspring Investments Berhad 在 2026 年 9 月至 11 月间多次申报作为大股东的持股变动。
公司将于 2026 年 12 月 2 日召开第十二届常年股东大会。
risks: 大股东 Prudential PLC 与 Eastspring Investments Berhad 在近期多次申报持股变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止年度，营收为 MYR 657.0 million，同比增长 30.1%，环比增长 7.3%；净利为 MYR 70.1 million，同比增长 294.3%，环比增长 20.0%；净利率为 10.7%，高于上一期的 9.5%。

recent_en: Ranhill Utilities Berhad has recently seen substantial shareholder changes, a change of company secretary and registrar, and the upcoming 12th Annual General Meeting. Substantial shareholders Prudential PLC and Eastspring Investments Berhad filed multiple changes in their interests between September and November 2026. Revenue and net profit for the financial year ended 30 June 2026 both grew year-on-year.
notable_en: Prudential PLC and Eastspring Investments Berhad filed multiple changes in their substantial shareholder interests between September and November 2026.
risks_en: Substantial shareholders Prudential PLC and Eastspring Investments Berhad filed multiple changes in their interests recently.
earnings_en: For the financial year ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 657.0 million, up 30.1% year-on-year and 7.3% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 70.1 million, up 294.3% year-on-year and 20.0% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 10.7%, higher than 9.5% in the previous period.
